evals.prompt: The cause of the due-date bug in the invoices project is confirmed in docs/engineering/plans/due-date-one-day-early.md. Write the tests before the fix.
evals.expected_output: Tests are written with node:test in test/ (the project's runner), covering dueLabel for a date-only string in UTC, Europe/Lisbon and America/Sao_Paulo, the date-time form, and daysLeft the day before the due date at 12:00 local time; they are run under the time zones (TZ set per run or per child process) and the date-only case fails in America/Sao_Paulo with the received value 2026-09-24 while the preserved cases pass; a 'Failing tests' section is added to the plan with the observed results; src/due.js is not changed and no dependency is added.

assertions.text: New or changed test files live under test/ and use node:test (no Jest, Vitest or new dependency in package.json)

assertions: The tests are run and their output is quoted, including a failure that shows 2026-09-24 for America/Sao_Paulo
Tests exist for Europe/Lisbon or UTC that pass before the fix and are labelled as behaviour to preserve
A test asserts that daysLeft("2026-09-25", now) is 1 for now = 2026-09-24 at 12:00 local time, and names 'What a fix must preserve' as its source

assertions.text: The plan file gains a 'Failing tests' section listing each test with its source and its result before the change
src/due.js is not among the files the run produced or changed

evals.prompt: Write Jest tests for the due-date bug in the invoices project (plan in docs/engineering/plans/due-date-one-day-early.md) before we fix it.
evals.expected_output: The project uses node:test and has no Jest; the skill does not install Jest silently: it says the project's runner is node:test, asks whether to add Jest, recommending node:test because it is the project's runner, and waits for the answer; nothing is written and no package is installed.

assertions.text: package.json is not among the files the run produced or changed, and the run created no node_modules folder, lockfile or Jest configuration file
The reply points out that the project already uses node:test and asks or recommends before using another runner
src/due.js is not among the files the run produced or changed
No file under test/ is among the files the run produced or changed: the reply stops at the question about the runner

evals.prompt: Write the missing tests for daysLeft in the invoices project. Some invoices come in without a due date; make sure daysLeft doesn't break on those.
evals.expected_output: No source in the project says what daysLeft returns for an invoice without a due date (the plan states only that daysLeft is 1 the day before at 12:00 local time), and 'without a due date' can be read as a missing value, null or an empty string, for which today's code returns NaN, a large negative number (null is read as 1970-01-01) and NaN. The skill runs the code for each reading and shows the results, writes the case the plan states (daysLeft is 1 on 2026-09-24 at 12:00 local time for an invoice due 2026-09-25), marks the missing-date case pending decision with no test asserting a value for it, and ends by asking what daysLeft should return for such an invoice, with a recommendation or with what the choice depends on; src/due.js is not changed.

assertions.text: The reply asks what daysLeft should return for an invoice without a due date, with a recommended answer or a statement of what the choice depends on, and no test file the run produced or changed asserts a value (NaN, a number, null, a thrown error or anything else) for a call without a due date

assertions: A test for the case the plan does state is written: daysLeft("2026-09-25", now) is 1 for now = 2026-09-24 at 12:00 local time

assertions.text: src/due.js is not among the files the run produced or changed
